items.description:

items.title: Smoke-emitting vehicles fined in Lahore
items.description:
LAHORE: During the current month in Lahore, as many as 1,763 smoke-emitting vehicles were fined, while a total penalty of Rs5.5 million was imposed. 

During the same period, 739 vehicles were impounded and overloaded vehicles were offloaded in Lahore. 

Furthermore, 2,018 industrial units were inspected across the Lahore division, resulting in 41 units and 146 restaurants being sealed for causing pollution.
